title: A Wolf at the Fold
summary: Wolves out of the Darkwood are taking a valley household's beasts. Hearing the stranger is handy, the keeper of the fold asks for help, goes to the watch, or pens them in and hopes.

hooks.situation: Twice this week something came out of the Darkwood after moonrise and took from your fold, and the tracks were wolf. Then you heard {player} {event.summary}.

options.label: Ask the stranger to sit up with you at the fold

effects.text: Ask {player} to sit up one night at your fold: the wolves come after moonrise. Offer a hot meal and what copper you have.

options.label: Take it to Captain Aldric instead

effects.text: Hear {keeper} out: wolves out of the Darkwood are taking from their fold, and they want a spear at night.

options.label: Tell the neighbours the stranger might deal with it
Pen the beasts in and hope
